sloka: अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् लक्ष्मणम् सत्य वादिनम् ।अनार्य करुणारंभ नृशंस कुल पांसन ॥३-४५-२१॥
transliteration: abravīt paruṣam vākyam lakṣmaṇam satya vādinam ।anārya karuṇāraṁbha nṛśaṁsa kula pāṁsana ॥3-45-21॥

translations.english: O ignoble, cruel Lakshmana, you are a disgrace to your family. I think this great disaster of Rama is a pleasure to you.
